meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会指导用户使用 Adaptyv Bio Foundry 的 API 和 Python SDK，帮助设计蛋白质实验、提交蛋白序列、跟踪实验状态并获取测定结果。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Adaptyv、蛋白结合/筛选测定（BLI/SPR）、热稳定性测定，或想提交蛋白序列做实验表征，或代码中导入相关 SDK 时触发。

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to guide use of the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for designing protein experiments, submitting sequences, tracking status, and retrieving assay results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions Adaptyv, protein binding/screening assays (BLI/SPR), thermostability assays, wants to submit protein sequences for characterization, or code imports the SDK.

Estimate the cost of BLI screening for 3 sequences.
Create and submit a thermostability experiment.
